caption: The drawing depicts a pair of tan, padded fabric vests connected together near the shoulder area by a thin strap. Both vests have a quilted pattern made up of repeated circular sections, and each vest has two large, rectangular flap pockets on the lower half, secured with red diamond-shaped button covers and blue trim along the edge of the flaps. The shoulder straps are wide and similarly quilted, with white rectangular patches and brown detailing on the upper outside edge of each strap. There are various small loops and adjustment straps attached to the vests, some of which are green or pale brown in color. The background is a plain, light beige surface with no additional objects or details present. The artist's signature, "John Thorton," appears in the lower right corner.
title: Money Vest
